channel.title: Platform Roles on KubeSphere Enterprise
channel.description: Recent content in Platform Roles on KubeSphere Enterprise

item.title: Create Platform Roles
item.description: This section explains how to create platform roles. KubeSphere provides the following preset platform roles, and you can also create roles to customize role permissions. Parameter Description platform-admin The platform administrator has all permissions on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. platform-regular The role cannot access any resources before joining a workspace, which is typically granted to workspace members who do not need other platform permissions.

item.title: View Platform Role List
item.description: This section explains how to view the platform role list. Prerequisites You should have the Role Viewing permission on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere Enterprise web console with a user who has the Role Viewing permission. Click Users and Roles. Select Platform Roles from the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Platform Role Information
item.description: This section explains how to edit platform role information. You can edit the alias and description of platform roles created by users. KubeSphere does not support editing preset platform roles and the names of platform roles. Prerequisites You should have the Role Management permission on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere Enterprise web console with a user who has the Role Management permission.

item.title: Delete Platform Roles
item.description: This section explains how to delete platform roles. You can delete platform roles created by users. Preset platform roles cannot be deleted. Prerequisites You should have the Role Management permission on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. If the platform role you want to delete has already been assigned to a user, you need to delete the user or modify their role.
